system.cost: Low for small; Moderate for medium-sized
system.description:
In the event of a life support failure, a breathable atmosphere can be created in a pressurized space by using a solid-fuel oxygen generator. A standard portable medium-sized version produces 75 manhours of oxygen once ignited. A smaller pocket-sized version produces 15 man-hours.

Source: Eclipse Phase Panopticon, p. 157.
